nodes.label: Woodpecker Logo (Brand Mark)
nodes.description: Stylized woodpecker bird head and neck in profile facing right, flat vector sports-mascot style on a transparent background. Red swept crest, navy-blue body and long pointed beak, white neck stripe and eye highlight. The white stripe and navy body form a bold letter 'W' at the base.

nodes.label: W Monogram
nodes.rationale: Negative/positive space in the bird's body forms a 'W' for Woodpecker, doubling the mascot as a lettermark.

nodes.label: Woodpecker Bird Mascot
nodes.rationale: The woodpecker's repetitive pecking is a visual metaphor for the Woodpecker Method's repeated drilling of the same puzzle set.

nodes.label: In-site Logo 256px (Woodpecker head, red crest, navy W body)
nodes.norm_label: in-site logo 256px (woodpecker head, red crest, navy w body)

nodes.label: Book 2 Extraction (extract/book2.py)
nodes.rationale: Exercise n becomes id 2000+n to avoid collisions with book 1; only the key move is the answer since later moves are non-forcing plans.

nodes.label: Explain the Idea (app/explain.py)
nodes.rationale: No free text: every sentence is a fact computed by python-chess using the same detectors as themes; shown only after solving to avoid spoilers; book commentary never used.

nodes.label: PDF Puzzle Extraction Pipeline (extract/)
nodes.rationale: Boards in PDF use Chess Merida font so they are read as text without OCR; every puzzle verified with python-chess (side to move must match solution, all mainline moves legal).

nodes.label: Tactical Theme Classifier (app/themes.py)
nodes.rationale: A pattern is only counted if the solution line proves it (e.g. fork must actually capture a target); 218 puzzles left unclassified rather than mislabeled.

nodes.label: data/puzzles.json
nodes.rationale: Stores FEN + solution line + players/event/year, deliberately without book commentary (copyright).

nodes.label: data/themes2.json (hand-reviewed strategic themes)
nodes.rationale: Keyword fallback (TEXT_PATTERNS) only ~59% accurate, so manual classification is authoritative; move-type guessing was removed.

nodes.label: Board Image Template Matching (extract/board_image.py)
nodes.rationale: Book 2 diagrams are images: squares binarized, diagonal dark-square hatching removed, then matched against templates from two hand-read boards with up to 3px shift.

nodes.label: Account Deletion (POST /api/auth/delete-account)
nodes.rationale: Explicit deletion in code because SQLite does not enforce ON DELETE CASCADE by default.

nodes.label: Sprint Mode (app/routers/sprint.py)
nodes.rationale: Uses book 1 only since timed races suit forcing tactics.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Move Validation (anti-cheat)
nodes.rationale: Server verifies every move and times the run; solution never reaches browser until the round/challenge ends, so records cannot be forged.

nodes.label: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy Backend (app/)
nodes.rationale: SQLite locally, PostgreSQL (Neon) in production.

nodes.label: Realtime WebSocket Hub (app/realtime.py)
nodes.rationale: Server-managed clock, 30s reconnect grace; hub is in process memory so server must run as a single process.

nodes.label: Render + Neon Free Deployment
nodes.rationale: Load reduced via gzip, fingerprinted /static/<hash>/ paths with year-long caching, and in-memory puzzle catalog.

nodes.label: Security Module (app/security.py)
nodes.rationale: Login lockouts, constant-time unknown-user path to prevent enumeration, strict CSP, cross-origin write/WebSocket rejection, real IP from last PROXY_HOPS of X-Forwarded-For.

nodes.label: Renderer Content-Security-Policy (connect-src none)
nodes.rationale: Offline desktop renderer: self-only scripts, no network connections, no form actions.

nodes.label: Single-Process Deployment Constraint
nodes.rationale: Realtime hub and rate limits are in memory; multi-process would need a shared store like Redis.

nodes.label: Pre-paint Boot Script (js/boot.js)
nodes.rationale: Loaded synchronously in head before stylesheets so theme applies before first paint.

nodes.label: Custom Theme Mode (custom-theme.js)
nodes.rationale: Derives remaining colors and auto-adjusts secondary text/accent to reach 4.5:1; stored in profile custom_theme and applied pre-paint via boot.js.

nodes.label: Motion System (static/js/motion.js)
nodes.rationale: All animations disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.label: Color Theme System (themes.css, 4.5:1 contrast)
nodes.rationale: Generated from a contrast-checked palette table; applied before first paint.

nodes.label: Topbar Navigation (Train, Learn, Review, Sprint, Puzzles, Statistics)
nodes.norm_label: topbar navigation (train, learn, review, sprint, puzzles, statistics)

nodes.label: Desktop Learn Page (lessons.js, learn-rules.js, drills.js)
nodes.rationale: Drills are randomly generated but each round is verified before display (par from shortest-path search, each target solvable).

nodes.label: Openings Trainer (openings.js, openings-ui.js)
nodes.rationale: Practice mode schedules clean runs at 1/3/7/14/30 days; three consecutive clean runs means mastery.

nodes.label: Woodpecker Brand Mark
